quarterly_data.signal: Correction filing (2026-08-24) to the 2026-03-13 disclosure of the AI NPU semiconductor ASIC design, development and supply contract with an undisclosed AI semiconductor company (contract dated 2026-03-12; term 2025-11-07 to 2027-12-31; customer withheld until 2027-12-31): an additional contract raised the amount from KRW 18,078,199,200 (16.17% of revenue) to KRW 18,232,098,400 (16.31%) - fixed portion KRW 12,281,822,600 (was KRW 12,244,110,400) and conditional portion KRW 5,950,275,800 (was KRW 5,854,088,800); in currency terms USD 8,708,000 + KRW 5,346,000,000 (was USD 8,604,000 + KRW 5,346,000,000). The payment schedule was reset to more milestone-based instalments (14% advance paid by 2025-12-31, 28.98% within 30 days of signing, the rest on milestones).
